notes: World VFX cue rules (mw-e29.3), bound to the same events as the physics and arrow audio sheets. A physics object that lands or is knocked into something kicks up a dust puff at the contact, oriented out of the surface it hit and bigger the more energy the impact had; a short per-object cooldown keeps a rolling barrel from smoking like a chimney. An arrow that strikes a surface (not a creature: the hit's DamageApplied shows that) puffs the same way, and layers its own impact effect (its `cues.impactVfx`, e.g. a water splash) on top; until those effects exist (mw-e29.11) dev builds mark where they would play. A breakable that breaks throws shards and dust, scaled by how loud its profile breaks. Something that catches fire burns with a looping flame attached to it until it is extinguished or burns out; if it is destroyed first the flame stops and its last flames finish. A door that meets something (mw-e03.18) puffs dust where it pressed.
